_comment: IFA spelling -> canonical club name, for data/ifa/*.json.
The sixteen Liga Bet names were not guessed: data/ifa/liga-bet-south-a-2017-18.json
overlaps English Wikipedia and all sixteen positions match, so each IFA name sits
opposite a name this dataset already had. That is where they come from.
Names absent here keep their IFA transliteration, the same treatment the ~900
unmapped English Wikipedia names get. Several were deliberately left out rather
than merged: a.s. Ashdod, Beitar Tel Aviv Holon, M.K. Jerusalem and Hapoel Lod
Bnei Regev all resemble clubs this dataset charts, and an over-merge would hand a
charted club seasons it never played. See decision 5.
The 2025/26 captures are abandoned seasons: they contribute no positions, only the
fact that a club was playing. Names in them are mapped only where the club is one
this project charts and the spelling is unambiguous. Deliberately left unmapped:
'מ.כ. נס ציונה' in Liga Gimel Merkaz, which is not necessarily Maccabi Nes Ziona -
מ.כ. is מועדון כדורגל, not מכבי - and 'מ.ס. ראשל"צ' in Liga Gimel Tel Aviv, which
is not necessarily Maccabi Rishon LeZion. Claiming either would put a charted club
on a pitch it may never have taken.
